PAWN BROKERS' (AMENDMENT) STATUTE NO. 01 OF 2015 OF THE CENTRAL PROVINCEPROVINCIAL COUNCIL
A Statute for making amendments in the Central Province Provincial Council Pawn Brokers' Statute No. 04 of2014.
Be it passed by the Provincial Council of the Central Province of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lankaas follows :
1. This Statute is defind as Central Province Provincial Council Pawn Brokers' (Amended)Statute No. 01 of 2015 and shall be effective from the date approved by the Governor ofCentral Province.

2. Pawn Brokers' Statute No. 04 of 2014 of Central Provincial Council (hereafter defined asMain Statute) versions mentioned in (b), Sub section (1) of Section 8 in the Pawn BrokersStatute (hereafter defined as Main Statute and Shall be substitute new versions mentionedbelow)

3. The 3rd Sub Section of Section 10 of the Main Statute is hereby amended as follows.

(3) Security deposits amount or amounts payable by a licence as intimated to licenceholder by the Commissioner of Revenue should be deposited to the Commissionerof Provincial Revenue. Amount in deposit thereon shall not be refunded to thedepositer except on closure or conveyance of business. However, if there is anyamount payable to a pawner or pawners of articles by the licencee, such amount shallbe deducted from the security deposits.
4. The Section 13 of the Main Statute is hereby amended as follows :
13. The Commissioner of Revenue shall be annually published in the Government Gazette,a notice containing,
(1) Name of licenced pawnbroker, name of the business and the address of the premiseswhere the business is carried on

(2) Every occasion when convicted under Section 39 such person's name, private address,name of busines and the address where the business was carried out and if the periodof validity of a licence has expired and a licence for the following year is not issued.
5. The Sub Section (3) of Section 28 of the Main Statute is hereby amended as follows :

(3) Where as person ceases to carry on the business as a pawnbroker the amount ofsecurity furnished by him/her (person) and thereon shall be payable to suchpawnbroker, after deducting any amount due for payment of any sum mentioned underSub section (1)
6. In the event of any inconsistency in the Sinhala, Tamil and English text of this Statute theSinhala text shall prevail.
